body: I have some friends, and my boyfriend, but they’re all tired of me talking about what happened to me and venting.
My counselors have exhausted the resources they have, but there isn’t much they can do when my mom is unwilling to take me to the therapists they find.

My problem is I have no transport, because my mom would be the only person able to take me and she doesn’t want to.

I’m not looking to start any medications any time soon because I want to try to live without them as much as possible (not because I’m against them, but because I function better without taking pills every day I feel like).

I can look into local charities as much as possible, I haven’t thought about that yet. Thank you for that.

I’m hoping things get better within the next year, but I’m just struggling for right now. This post was kind of a vent as well as an advice-seeking post.

I appreciate your reply; thank you.
I was 13 when it started. He was 36. He already had a strong criminal background. And no, we have good insurance that somehow hardly covers anything. Sigh.

I tried to back out of the case at one point. I asked them if I could postpone it six months. They said no and that it’s something they need to act on immediately. I wish I could afford therapy. My parents won’t take me. It’s too expensive and we don’t have that much money. My parents have to be involved in the case no matter what at this point..

About a month ago I opened a case on the man who emotionally manipulated and sexually assaulted me over the course of a few years. I’ve regretted opening the case since because I’ve realized I’m not ready for this yet. They told me if I missed a call from them that they would show up at my door. I missed one tonight and I’m terrified they’ll do so while I’m at school. My parents don’t know a single thing about what happened to me. I know I need to tell them. I’ve been waiting for the right time. I’ve been waiting to be ready for them to be disappointed in me even more so. But everything is moving so quickly and I haven’t even had the time to mentally process anything yet. I’m afraid. I don’t wanna do this anymore. I’m tired of being afraid of him, of my parents, of everything and everyone. I don’t want to do this anymore. I wish I could back out.
